items.t: Eaton (ETN) Will Supply Hydraulic And Fuel Systems For A New Business Jet
items.sum: Eaton (NYSE: ETN) has been selected by Dassault Aviation to supply hydraulic power and fuel system technologies for the Falcon 10X business jet. The agreement includes Eaton's involvement in safety certification and system validation processes for the new ultra long range aircraft. The Falcon 10X contract extends Eaton's aerospace footprint alongside its existing grid and electrification operation
